import os
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import math

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/160-6/1_160-6_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/160-6_2_10bd2e9e/1_160-6_output.xlsx"
sheet_name = "SH"

# Read the sheet with pandas to compute the compacted rows
df = pd.read_excel(input_path, sheet_name=sheet_name, header=0)

# Drop rows that are completely blank (all-NaN)
non_blank = df.dropna(how="all").reset_index(drop=True)

# Create a new DataFrame of the same length as original by placing non-blank rows at the top
# and filling the remainder with NaNs so that indexing aligns with Excel rows.
total_rows = len(df)
cols = df.columns.tolist()
df_compacted = pd.DataFrame(columns=cols, index=range(total_rows))
# Fill top rows with non_blank
for i in range(len(non_blank)):
    df_compacted.iloc[i] = non_blank.iloc[i]
# Remaining rows remain NaN (already)

# Now write only the target range SH!A6:L11 (Excel rows 6..11, cols A..L => first 12 columns)
# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
# Load workbook and sheet
wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb[sheet_name]

start_row = 6
end_row = 11
start_col = 1  # column A
end_col = 12   # column L

# For mapping: pandas df_compacted index 0 corresponds to Excel row 2 (since header is row 1).
# Therefore, Excel row R corresponds to df_compacted index (R - 2).
for excel_r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    df_idx = excel_r - 2
    for col_idx in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        df_col = col_idx - 1  # df columns 0-based
        # If df_idx is within bounds, get value; else treat as blank
        value = None
        if 0 <= df_idx < len(df_compacted):
            # Use .iat for speed; handle NaN -> None
            try:
                v = df_compacted.iat[df_idx, df_col]
            except Exception:
                v = None
            if pd.isna(v):
                value = None
            else:
                # Convert numpy types to native Python types for openpyxl
                if isinstance(v, (pd.Timestamp,)):
                    value = v.to_pydatetime()
                elif isinstance(v, (float, int)) and (not math.isfinite(v)):
                    value = None
                else:
                    value = v
        else:
            value = None
        ws.cell(row=excel_r, column=col_idx, value=value)

# Save workbook to output_path
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen the saved file and print SH!A6:L11 to confirm
df_out = pd.read_excel(output_path, sheet_name=sheet_name, header=0)
# Excel row 6 corresponds to df index 4 (since df index 0 -> Excel row 2)
verify_start_idx = start_row - 2
verify_end_idx = end_row - 2  # inclusive index
print("Values written to SH!A6:L11 (rows {} to {}):".format(start_row, end_row))
# Print the slice of rows and only the first 12 columns to match A:L
